name: Syncthing
description: Keeps folders in sync between your devices, with no cloud in between

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Syncthing's settings, device keys and database, plus the Default Folder (Sync). Back up the config folder: it holds this device's ID.

paths.name: Cache
paths.description: Your MOS storage, at the same path inside, so you can share any folder under /mnt/cache.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: STGUIADDRESS
variables.description: Where the web page listens. Leave it at 0.0.0.0:6793, the same number as the app's port.
